# Compiz - An OpenGL window manager & compositing manager
Compiz is an OpenGL based compositing manager that provides a hardware-accelerated window management enviroment with visual effects and desktop interaction features through a plugin system

## Features
 - OpenGL Accelerated compositing
 - Modular PLugin architecture
     - Includes Configurable behaviour hooks
 - Window Management
 - Window effects & animations
